defectName: Search returns duplicate itineraries
defectDescription: Round-trip search can return the same itinerary twice when fare families differ only in internal pricing identifiers.

defectName: Nonstop filter includes connecting flight
defectDescription: Applying the nonstop filter can leave an itinerary containing a technical connection.

defectName: Traveler profile loses phone country code
defectDescription: Saving an updated traveler profile can drop the phone country code and cause notification delivery failures.

defectName: Passport expiration validation accepts expired document
defectDescription: International traveler validation incorrectly accepts an already expired passport for some date formats.

defectName: Payment retry creates duplicate authorization
defectDescription: A retry after a payment timeout can create a second card authorization instead of reusing the original transaction state.

defectName: Payment failure message hides decline reason
defectDescription: Checkout returns a generic error when the payment provider supplies a customer-actionable decline category.

defectName: Retry button remains disabled after recoverable failure
defectDescription: The payment retry control does not become available after a recoverable gateway timeout.

defectName: Booking receipt shows incorrect tax total
defectDescription: The confirmation receipt can display an incorrect tax subtotal when multiple passenger types are present.

defectName: Seat map displays occupied seat as available
defectDescription: Seat availability can become stale and show an already assigned seat as selectable.

defectName: Extra-legroom seat price not refreshed
defectDescription: Premium seat pricing is not refreshed after itinerary repricing and can show an outdated amount.

defectName: Check-in eligibility ignores document restriction
defectDescription: Online check-in can be offered even when an international document check requires airport verification.

defectName: Checked-in status not persisted after refresh
defectDescription: A successful check-in can appear incomplete after the itinerary page is refreshed.

defectName: Boarding pass barcode fails scanner validation
defectDescription: Generated boarding-pass barcode contains an invalid segment sequence for a subset of connecting itineraries.

defectName: Prepaid baggage quantity exceeds allowance
defectDescription: The baggage purchase flow allows more checked bags than the configured itinerary maximum.

defectName: Transferred bag event displayed out of order
defectDescription: Baggage tracking can display a transfer event before the bag-loaded event due to event timestamp handling.

defectName: Delayed baggage notification sent twice
defectDescription: A delayed-bag event can trigger duplicate push notifications when the same operational event is replayed.

defectName: Flight delay status not refreshed
defectDescription: Flight status can remain on-time after an operational delay event has been received.

defectName: Gate change SMS uses previous gate
defectDescription: The SMS notification template can contain the old gate while the app displays the new gate.

defectName: Cancelled itinerary not detected for rebooking
defectDescription: A cancellation event on the first segment is not always marked as a disrupted itinerary.

defectName: Alternate flight ranking prefers later arrival
defectDescription: Recovery search can rank a later-arriving alternate above an earlier valid option.

defectName: Rebooking confirmation retains cancelled segment
defectDescription: After self-service rebooking, the confirmation can still display the cancelled flight segment.

defectName: Refund calculation includes nonrefundable seat fee
defectDescription: Cancellation refund calculation incorrectly includes a nonrefundable premium seat fee.

defectName: Refund submitted twice after client retry
defectDescription: A client retry after a timeout can submit the same refund request more than once.

defectName: Refund completion email not sent
defectDescription: Refund status reaches completed but the customer notification is not generated.

defectName: Reward redemption balance not updated
defectDescription: After points are redeemed, the displayed loyalty balance can remain unchanged until the next login.

defectName: Expired travel credit accepted
defectDescription: Checkout can accept a travel credit that expired earlier on the same calendar day in another timezone.

defectName: Voucher can be redeemed concurrently
defectDescription: Concurrent checkout requests can consume the same promotional voucher more than once.

defectName: Wheelchair request missing from itinerary
defectDescription: A saved wheelchair assistance request does not appear in the final itinerary summary.

defectName: Multi-city search drops third segment
defectDescription: A three-leg multi-city itinerary can omit the third segment after fare repricing.

defectName: Passport validation rejects valid leap-day expiry
defectDescription: A valid passport expiry date on February 29 is rejected by document validation.

defectName: Booking lookup fails for hyphenated surname
defectDescription: Manage booking cannot retrieve some reservations when the traveler surname contains a hyphen.

defectName: Fare difference rounded incorrectly
defectDescription: Changing an itinerary can round the fare difference incorrectly for currencies without two decimal minor units.

defectName: Final boarding call sent after boarding closed
defectDescription: Final-call notification can be delivered after the flight boarding status has already changed to closed.

defectName: Recommendation shown despite personalization opt-out
defectDescription: A personalized ancillary recommendation can appear for a customer who disabled personalization.

defectName: Fare alert triggered by insignificant price change
defectDescription: Fare monitoring sends an alert for a price movement below the customer's configured threshold.

defectName: Booking failure alert lacks correlation ID
defectDescription: Critical booking alerts do not include the transaction correlation identifier required for rapid incident diagnosis.
